full_prompt_en:
A painted science-fiction adventure scene catches two travelers midflight across a steep alien slope. The nearer figure in rust red lunges diagonally downward, one arm braced against a rocky bank, while the smaller figure in yellow green follows with a long implement held out for balance. Dense orange growth rises in rolling clustered masses overhead, and dark blue-black ridges press in from the upper left. Pale mint vegetation and a narrow blue stream thread through the lower ground. The composition is crowded and urgent, yet its diagonal path leaves enough clear space to read the figures' movement at a glance.

An illustrative painted surface has visible small directional brush marks, soft blended passages in the mist and foliage, and crisp dark accents along hands, faces, folds, and broken stone. Warm vermilion, copper, and ochre command the upper image, offset by cool jade, icy turquoise, slate blue, and near-black. A bright diffuse glow on the pale growth and water lifts the foreground against the darker mass behind it. Shapes are modeled with substantial value changes rather than flat fills; the clustered forms have a scalloped, almost cloudlike rhythm. A dramatic pulp-cover sense of danger and discovery accompanies tactile roughness in the landscape and a slightly softened painterly finish rather than polished photographic detail. No legible lettering appears in this selected panel.
full_prompt_zh:
一幅绘制的科幻冒险场景，捕捉两名旅者在陡峭异星山坡上奔逃的瞬间。近处穿锈红色的人物沿对角线向下跃进，一只手抵住岩岸；较小的黄绿色人物随后而行，向外伸出长形器具维持平衡。橙色的浓密生长物在上方聚成翻卷的团块，左上方的深蓝黑色山脊向画面内压来。淡薄荷色植被与一道狭窄的蓝色水流穿过下方地面。构图紧凑而急促，但倾斜的通路保留足够的清晰空间，使人物的动作一眼可辨。

画面采用插画式绘画表面，可见细小而有方向的笔触；雾气与枝叶有柔和晕开的区域，手部、面部、褶痕和破碎岩石则由清晰的深色重音勾出。朱红、铜橙与赭黄主导上半幅，和玉绿、冰蓝绿、石板蓝及近黑色形成冷暖对照。淡色生长物与水面上的明亮散射光，将前景从身后的暗色块中托出。形体靠明显的明度变化塑造，而不是平涂；成簇的形状呈现扇贝边缘般、近似云团的节奏。旧式科幻封面的危险与发现感伴随地貌可触的粗糙度，整体呈现略柔和的绘画效果。所选画面中没有可辨认文字。
style_prompt_en: An illustrative painted surface gathers dense, scalloped masses above a steep diagonal passage. Warm vermilion, copper, and ochre occupy broad upper areas, meeting jade, icy turquoise, slate blue, and near-black below. Small directional brush marks build texture across rough forms, while softer blended color lets misty intervals and luminous pale passages breathe. Dark, crisp accents pick out a few folds, edges, and broken contours without outlining every shape. The strongest brightness gathers in cool, pale regions against a compressed dark surround. Substantial shifts in value give the shapes weight and depth; repeating rounded clusters establish a rolling rhythm that counters the sharp diagonal movement. The finish has the energy of a painted adventure illustration, tactile and dramatic, with controlled detail and a slight softness at the margins.
style_prompt_zh: 插画式绘画表面让密集的扇贝状团块汇聚在陡斜的通道上方。朱红、铜橙和赭黄占据上方大片区域，在下方与玉绿、冰蓝绿、石板蓝及近黑色相接。细小而有方向的笔触在粗糙形体上积累纹理，较柔和的晕色则让雾状间隙与发亮的浅色区域得以呼吸。清晰的深色重音只挑出少量褶线、边缘与断裂轮廓，并不把所有形状都封闭勾线。最强的亮度集中在受暗色围合的冷调浅色部分。明显的明度转折赋予形状重量和深度；反复出现的圆团建立翻滚的节奏，与锐利的对角线动势相对。整体有绘制冒险插画的活力，触感鲜明、戏剧性强，细节受到控制，边缘略微柔和。
theme_en: A breathless escape across a perilous alien slope
theme_zh: 穿越险峻异星山坡的仓促逃离
name: Ed Emshwiller
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
